scripts.dev: concurrently "cd backend;bun run start:dev" "cd backend-tools;bun run start:dev" "cd frontend;npm run dev"
scripts.build: cd backend && bun run build && cd ../backend-tools && bun run build && cd ../frontend && npm run build
scripts.precommit-check: npm run build && echo 'Build passed!' || (echo 'Build failed! Commit aborted.' && exit 1)
